title: Default TFR Questionnaire
description: Default file review questionnaire for validating documentation, estimate support, and repair-scope opportunities.

questions.text: Was the file documentation sufficient to support the estimate decision?

sub_questions.text: Documentation is missing, incomplete, or insufficient to support the estimate decision.
sub_questions.reasoning: Test case: file evidence is assumed to lack sufficient estimate-supporting documentation (e.g., notes/photos/line-item detail/attachments) to substantiate the estimate decision.
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the missing or insufficient notes, photos, estimate details, or attachments.

questions.help_text: Review notes, photos, estimate line items, and supporting attachments.

questions.text: Were all applicable repair opportunities addressed?

sub_questions.text: An applicable repair item appears missing or under-scoped.
sub_questions.reasoning: Test case: an applicable repair opportunity is assumed to be missing or under-scoped in the estimate.
sub_questions.help_text: Cite the file evidence that supports the opportunity.

outcome_justification: Test case: Documentation is insufficient to support the estimate decision (Q1=No) and an applicable repair opportunity appears missing or under-scoped (Q2=No).
